checks.detail: The real Settings UI shows Release candidate ready (release-candidate-ready) declaring the typed ReleaseCandidateReady event before it is fired once.

The captured recent-events observation records event dcf2a818-080a-4dc2-84db-d11a60b6e69c at 1787639193, produced by skill:release-candidate-ready with type ReleaseCandidateReady and the exact payload retained in identities.
That Skill dispatch created durable release-gate-review run bf52db2e-14b7-4e3e-ae9e-7f565133dc44 with the same trigger timestamp and payload; gate-review completed before operator-review parked.

The operator resumed the same durable run, and reloaded completed history exposes its stored Result: Evidence received. Keep the release gated until repository checks and remaining risks are reviewed by an operator.
